onboarding.subtitle: Set up your pocket account in just a few steps

step1.question: Choose your language
step1.why: Pocket will show everything in your preferred language.

step2.question: What's your name?
step2.why: So we can personalize your experience.
step2.hint: Let us know how to address you.

step3.question: What's your email?
step3.why: This is how you'll sign in.
step3.hint: We'll use this to keep your account secure.

step5.question: Where are you located?
step5.why: To set your default currency and formats.

step6.question: Currency and formats
step6.why: We'll use these to display your amounts and dates.

step7.question: What's your bank called?
step7.why: We'll create rules to recognize your own transfers.
step7.hint: Enter the name of your main bank as it appears on statements.

step8.question: Do you share finances with someone?
step8.why: We'll set up rules for shared account transfers.
step8.nameHint: What's their name? We'll create rules to identify shared transfers.
